articles.title: AI and experiments reveal impurities hindering waste plastic pyrolysis oil recycling
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: A Korean research team has identified how impurities interfere with the use of waste plastic pyrolysis oil as a petrochemical feedstock through catalytic experiments and artificial intelligence (AI)-based computational chemistry.
